reason: A DeepSeek Harness WebUI control for pausing active agent work, stopping related processes and child agents, and prompting the agent to summarize progress and await new requirements.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供可自定义的打断按钮，用于暂停智能体工作、停止相关任务并引导其总结进展后等待新要求。
summaries.en: Adds a customizable interrupt button to DeepSeek Harness WebUI that pauses agent work, stops related tasks, and prompts a progress summary before awaiting new requirements.

capabilities: Interrupts active agent turns and tool calls
Kills agent-owned background jobs and terminals
Interrupts child agents and disarms automatic continuation goals
Preserves queued messages and sends a customizable interruption prompt
